messages:
elena: Thanks everyone for joining the runtime portion of the all-hands. Quick follow-up: I promised a short action checklist for priorities — dropping it here so we can clarify.

samir: Thanks! Can we confirm the short-term perf priorities? Is it 1) batching window improvements 2) KV cache TTLs 3) kernel selection heuristics?

ja: Correct for sprint-1. Also add 4) better op fusion for int8 paths.

matt: Two clarifying questions: a) what's the target latency SLO we gate on for canaries? b) do we have a rollback plan tied to token-cost or just p99 latency?

elena: Good q. For canaries we gate on p99 latency + tail ratio (p99/p50) and an end-to-end correctness smoke — not token-cost. Rollback is automated if p99 exceeds 20% over baseline OR if regressions in our core eval set are detected.

samir: On caching: what's the current TTL defaults? I thought we had per-model defaults but wanted to confirm if we should shorten for personalization workloads.

ja: Current defaults are 5m for prefix cache + 24h for session-level embeddings. For personalization we should add a flag to opt into shorter TTLs (e.g., 30s) — that's on the sprint TODO.

ana: @elena is the canary cadence still every 6 hours for runtime kernels?

elena: We're moving to 3 hours for critical kernels (attention/fused-matmul) during the rollout window, with quieter kernels staying at 6h. Ops will throttle if infra pressure spikes.

matt: For kernel selection heuristics: are we shipping the ML-driven selector in this sprint or a rules-based fallback?

ja: Shipping a hybrid: rules-first with telemetry hooks for the ML selector to collect labeled examples. Full ML selector targeted next quarter.

samir: Small ops note — please ensure the canary runs include at least one Dedicated cluster and one Hosted region to catch provider-specific regressions.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started: runtime/kernel-v2 on cluster-dedicated-8 at 1902345800. Monitoring: latency, errors, eval-regressions.

elena: Thanks @ops-bot. Action items from this thread: 
- Samir: shorten prefix cache TTLs flag + doc (owner, sprint-1)
- Jia: add int8 op-fusion ticket and perf target (owner, sprint-1)
- Matt: define canary gating thresholds + rollback playbook draft (owner, this week)
- Ops: ensure canary includes dedicated + hosted (owner: ana)

ana: noted, I'll patch the canary manifest and confirm once running.

matt: One more: how do we track token-cost regressions in CI? Need a metric that correlates to model change impact.

\elja: Add a lightweight token-cost delta check in post-deploy evals — compare median tokens-per-output and compute cost delta using current pricing table. If >5% deviation without quality gain flag, fail canary.

samir: sounds reasonable. Also proposing a short doc (2 paragraphs) we can link from the console explaining the trade-offs for users on caching vs latency. I'll draft it.

elena: Great. If there are no blockers I'll summarize these in the runtime sprint doc and ping the owners. Closing thread unless more questions. :thumbsup:
